title: GTA6 Launch Nears as GTA 5 PS Plus Extra Removal Date Confirmed
description: GTA 5 is leaving PS Plus Extra just days before GTA 6 launches. Find out the exact removal date and what it means for players wanting a final replay.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 5 Says Goodbye to PS Plus Extra Ahead of GTA 6

If you want to replay GTA 5 before GTA 6 comes out via your PS Plus Extra subscription, you will need to get a move on. According to gaming outlet Push Square, Rockstar's massive open-world title has been officially confirmed for removal from the subscription service.

The timing of this departure has caught the attention of the gaming community. The open-world epic is scheduled to leave PS Plus Extra on 17th November 2026. What makes this departure particularly striking is that it happens just two days before GTA 6 arrives. For players relying on the subscription tier to experience or revisit Los Santos, this creates a strict deadline before the service loses the title.

### What This Means for Players

Subscription services like PS Plus Extra rotate their game catalogs regularly, but the exit of a heavyweight title like GTA 5 right on the heels of a major franchise milestone is noteworthy. Players who wish to squeeze in one last playthrough through the subscription library must act quickly before mid-November. After that date, accessing the game will require purchasing it separately, unless it returns to a subscription tier in the future.

### Editor's Take

The removal of GTA 5 right before the launch of GTA 6 feels like a symbolic changing of the guard. While game rotations are standard for subscription platforms, the timing is a stark reminder to players to finish their playthroughs early if they rely on PS Plus Extra.
